raw_requirement: Create an 18 kW motor drive panel using Schneider ATV630.

extracted_params.application: Industrial Variable Speed Drive (VFD) Control Panel (18.5 kW)
extracted_params.motor_kw_note: User specified 18 kW; standard industrial IEC motor/drive size is 18.5 kW (25 HP, approx 38A FLA at 415V).
extracted_params.control_type: Local/Remote Selector with Start/Stop and Emergency Stop
provisional_assumptions: Provisional Assumption: 415V 3-Phase 50Hz standard Indian/European industrial supply.
Provisional Assumption: Standard IEC 18.5 kW class motor sizing.
Provisional Assumption: Enclosure rated IP54 indoor wall/floor mount with cooling fan and filter.
Provisional Assumption: Bottom cable entry for supply feeder and motor cabling.
Provisional Assumption: 24V DC control circuit powered by dedicated regulated SMPS.

bom.name: Variable Frequency Drive 18.5 kW
bom.description: Altivar Process ATV630 18.5 kW / 25 HP, 3-Ph 380-480V, 39.2A normal duty, IP21

bom.name: Molded Case Circuit Breaker (MCCB) 63A 3P

bom.name: MCCB Extended Rotary Operating Handle
bom.description: Door interlocked rotary handle mechanism with shaft and padlocking
bom.notes: External door isolation with door lock when energized

bom.description: Feed-through high-current DIN terminal blocks for R-S-T mains incoming

bom.name: Motor Output Terminal Block 35 sq mm (Set of 3)
bom.description: Feed-through high-current DIN terminal blocks for U-V-W motor outgoing

bom.name: Earth (PE) Copper Busbar Bar 25x5mm
bom.description: High conductivity electrolytic copper earth busbar with M6 tapped studs

bom.name: Regulated Switch Mode Power Supply 24V DC 2.5A
bom.description: Ultra slim 60W 24V DC 2.5A DIN rail power supply 85-264V AC input

bom.name: Control Circuit MCB 2-Pole 6A C-Curve
bom.description: Acti9 iC60N 2P 6A 10kA miniature circuit breaker for SMPS AC supply

bom.name: DC Branch Circuit MCB 1-Pole 4A B-Curve
bom.description: Acti9 iC60N 1P 4A miniature circuit breaker for 24V DC field wiring
bom.notes: Overcurrent protection for 24V DC field loop circuits

bom.name: Slim Interface Relay 24V DC 1CO with LED Base
bom.description: Plug-in interface relay 24V DC coil with socket, LED and surge suppression

bom.description: Harmony XB4 22mm trigger action red mushroom e-stop twist-to-release 2NC

bom.name: Stop Push Button (Red Flush)

bom.name: LED Pilot Indicating Lamps 22.5mm (Set of 4: R-Y-B & Green Run)

bom.name: Control Terminal Block 2.5 sq mm
bom.description: DIN rail feed-through terminal blocks 800V 24A for digital/analog I/O
bom.notes: Field control wiring strip (16 physical units, total strip width ~96mm)

bom.name: Cable Gland Assortment Pack (M40, M32, M20, M16)

bom.notes: Mechanical sealing and strain relief for external cables
